slides.title: Robots get bored? Not Bolt!
slides.text: Sometimes Bolt must do the same steps again and again. Writing them all out takes a long time.

slides.title: Spot the pattern
slides.text: Look for steps that repeat. A pattern is a group of steps that shows up more than once.

slides.title: Fewer blocks
slides.text: Four move blocks do the same job as one repeat block.

slides.title: Count the times
slides.text: The number on a loop is how many times the whole bracket runs. It is not the number of squares.

slides.title: Words to know
slides.text: These words help you talk about loops.

words.means: a group of steps that shows up again

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Use repeat blocks to get Bolt to the flag with as few blocks as you can.
